classification_categories.ambiguous: Text present but insufficient to classify

To ensure robust statistical power for identifying subclonal architectures and reconstructing lung cancer evolutionary histories, we applied the number of reads per tumor chromosomal copy (NRPCC) metric to evaluate sequencing depth in relation to tumor ploidy. Based on stringent quality control criteria (NRPCC > 10, purity > 0.3, and reliable copy-number profiling), we selected 542 LUAD tumors for downstream clonal evolution analyses.
